englishDefinition: A computing system of connected nodes loosely modeled on the brain.
exampleSentence: The neural network was trained on millions of labeled images.
exampleTranslation: 这个神经网络是在数百万张已标注的图像上训练的。

englishDefinition: The dataset used to teach a machine learning model.
exampleSentence: The quality of the training data directly affects model performance.
exampleTranslation: 训练数据的质量直接影响模型的表现。

englishDefinition: When a model learns the training data too closely and performs poorly on new data.
exampleSentence: Adding dropout layers helped reduce overfitting on the small dataset.
exampleTranslation: 添加 dropout 层有助于减少在小数据集上的过拟合。

englishDefinition: The process of using a trained model to make predictions.
exampleSentence: Inference latency matters more than training time in production.
exampleTranslation: 在生产环境中，推理延迟比训练时间更重要。

englishDefinition: A standard test used to compare the performance of models or systems.
exampleSentence: The new model outperformed the previous one on every benchmark.
exampleTranslation: 新模型在每一项基准测试中都优于之前的模型。

englishDefinition: Further training a pretrained model on a smaller, task-specific dataset.
exampleSentence: Fine-tuning the base model on our support tickets improved accuracy significantly.
exampleTranslation: 在我们的工单数据上对基础模型进行微调，显著提升了准确率。

englishDefinition: A numeric vector representation that captures the meaning of text, images, or other data.
exampleSentence: We store each document as an embedding to power semantic search.
exampleTranslation: 我们把每篇文档存成一个嵌入向量，用来实现语义搜索。

englishDefinition: A neural network architecture that uses self-attention to process sequences.
exampleSentence: Most modern language models are built on the transformer architecture.
exampleTranslation: 大多数现代语言模型都建立在 transformer 架构之上。

englishDefinition: A portion of data held out to tune a model and check its performance during training.
exampleSentence: We track accuracy on the validation set after every training epoch.
exampleTranslation: 我们在每个训练轮次之后都会检查模型在验证集上的准确率。

englishDefinition: A configuration value set before training that controls how a model learns.
exampleSentence: Tuning the learning rate hyperparameter had the biggest impact on performance.
exampleTranslation: 调整学习率这个超参数对模型表现的影响最大。

englishDefinition: A machine learning approach that trains a model on labeled input-output pairs.
exampleSentence: Supervised learning worked well here because we had thousands of labeled examples.
exampleTranslation: 由于我们拥有数千个已标注的样本，监督学习在这里效果很好。

englishDefinition: A machine learning approach that finds patterns in data without labeled outputs.
exampleSentence: Unsupervised learning grouped customers into segments nobody had defined in advance.
exampleTranslation: 无监督学习把客户自动分成了几个此前没有人预先定义的群体。

englishDefinition: A learning approach that uses a small amount of labeled data alongside a large amount of unlabeled data.
exampleSentence: Semi-supervised learning let us use the ten thousand unlabeled images we hadn't annotated yet.
exampleTranslation: 半监督学习让我们能够利用那一万张还没标注的图像。

englishDefinition: A learning approach where an agent learns to make decisions by receiving rewards or penalties.
exampleSentence: Reinforcement learning trained the agent to win the game through millions of trial-and-error episodes.
exampleTranslation: 强化学习通过数百万次试错让智能体学会了如何赢得这个游戏。

englishDefinition: A learning approach where the model generates its own supervisory signal from unlabeled data.
exampleSentence: Self-supervised learning let the model pretrain on raw text without any human labels.
exampleTranslation: 自监督学习让模型能够在没有任何人工标注的情况下，直接用原始文本进行预训练。

englishDefinition: The process of creating input variables that help a model learn more effectively.
exampleSentence: Feature engineering added a day-of-week column that turned out to be highly predictive.
exampleTranslation: 特征工程增加了一个"星期几"的字段，结果证明它有很强的预测能力。

englishDefinition: The process of transforming raw data into a set of measurable features for a model.
exampleSentence: Feature extraction from the audio files reduced each clip to just twenty numbers.
exampleTranslation: 从音频文件中进行的特征提取，把每段音频压缩成了仅二十个数字。

englishDefinition: The correct output or category assigned to a piece of training data.
exampleSentence: Each image in the dataset had a single label indicating which animal it showed.
exampleTranslation: 数据集中的每张图像都有一个标签，标明了图中是哪种动物。

englishDefinition: The verified, correct data used as a reference to evaluate a model's predictions.
exampleSentence: The model's predictions were compared against ground truth labeled by human experts.
exampleTranslation: 模型的预测结果与由人类专家标注的真实标注进行了对比。

englishDefinition: A function that measures how far a model's predictions are from the true values.
exampleSentence: Switching the loss function to focal loss helped the model handle rare classes better.
exampleTranslation: 把损失函数换成 focal loss 后，模型对稀有类别的处理效果更好了。

englishDefinition: An optimization algorithm that adjusts model parameters to minimize a loss function.
exampleSentence: Gradient descent gradually reduced the loss over thousands of training steps.
exampleTranslation: 梯度下降在数千个训练步骤中逐渐降低了损失值。

englishDefinition: The algorithm used to compute gradients and update weights in a neural network.
exampleSentence: Backpropagation efficiently computed how much each weight contributed to the error.
exampleTranslation: 反向传播高效地计算出了每个权重对误差的贡献程度。

englishDefinition: A hyperparameter that controls how much model weights are adjusted during training.
exampleSentence: A learning rate that was too high caused the training loss to bounce around instead of decreasing.
exampleTranslation: 学习率过高导致训练损失不断波动，而不是稳步下降。

englishDefinition: Techniques used to prevent a model from overfitting by penalizing complexity.
exampleSentence: Adding regularization brought the validation accuracy much closer to the training accuracy.
exampleTranslation: 加入正则化后，验证集准确率与训练集准确率之间的差距明显缩小了。

englishDefinition: The balance between a model being too simple (high bias) and too complex (high variance).
exampleSentence: Understanding the bias-variance tradeoff helped us pick a model that generalized well.
exampleTranslation: 理解偏差-方差权衡帮助我们选择了一个泛化能力更好的模型。

englishDefinition: A situation where a model is too simple to capture the underlying pattern in the data.
exampleSentence: Underfitting was obvious once both training and validation accuracy stayed low.
exampleTranslation: 一旦发现训练集和验证集的准确率都很低，欠拟合的问题就很明显了。

englishDefinition: A technique for evaluating a model by training and testing it on different data splits.
exampleSentence: Five-fold cross-validation gave a more reliable estimate of the model's true performance.
exampleTranslation: 五折交叉验证给出了对模型真实性能更可靠的估计。

englishDefinition: A technique that combines multiple models to produce better predictions than any single one.
exampleSentence: Ensemble learning combined three different models to boost overall accuracy.
exampleTranslation: 集成学习结合了三个不同的模型，提升了整体准确率。

englishDefinition: A model that makes predictions by following a tree of if-then rules.
exampleSentence: The decision tree was easy to explain to stakeholders who weren't technical.
exampleTranslation: 决策树很容易向不懂技术的干系人解释清楚。

englishDefinition: An ensemble method that combines many decision trees to improve prediction accuracy.
exampleSentence: The random forest outperformed a single decision tree on almost every metric.
exampleTranslation: 随机森林在几乎每一项指标上都优于单一决策树。

englishDefinition: A model that finds the optimal boundary separating classes of data.
exampleSentence: The support vector machine worked well on the small, high-dimensional dataset.
exampleTranslation: 支持向量机在这个小规模、高维度的数据集上表现良好。

englishDefinition: A model that classifies a data point based on the labels of its closest neighbors.
exampleSentence: K-nearest neighbors was simple to implement but slow on the full-sized dataset.
exampleTranslation: K 近邻算法实现起来很简单，但在完整数据集上运行较慢。

englishDefinition: The task of grouping data points so that similar points end up in the same group.
exampleSentence: Clustering revealed three distinct customer behavior patterns we hadn't noticed before.
exampleTranslation: 聚类揭示出了三种我们此前未曾注意到的客户行为模式。

englishDefinition: Techniques for reducing the number of input variables while preserving important information.
exampleSentence: Dimensionality reduction made the dataset small enough to visualize in two dimensions.
exampleTranslation: 降维让数据集变得足够小，可以在二维平面上进行可视化。

englishDefinition: A dimensionality reduction technique that projects data onto its directions of greatest variance.
exampleSentence: Principal component analysis reduced two hundred features down to just ten.
exampleTranslation: 主成分分析把两百个特征压缩到了仅十个。

englishDefinition: A task where a model predicts which category a given input belongs to.
exampleSentence: This was a binary classification problem: either the email was spam or it wasn't.
exampleTranslation: 这是一个二分类问题：邮件要么是垃圾邮件，要么不是。

englishDefinition: A task where a model predicts a continuous numeric value.
exampleSentence: We framed house price prediction as a regression problem rather than classification.
exampleTranslation: 我们把房价预测定义为一个回归问题，而不是分类问题。

englishDefinition: A table showing the counts of correct and incorrect predictions across each class.
exampleSentence: The confusion matrix revealed the model was mixing up two visually similar classes.
exampleTranslation: 混淆矩阵显示模型经常把两个外观相似的类别搞混。

englishDefinition: The process of choosing the most relevant features to use in a model.
exampleSentence: Feature selection dropped twelve columns that added noise without improving accuracy.
exampleTranslation: 特征选择去掉了十二个只增加噪声却无助于提升准确率的字段。

englishDefinition: A model's ability to perform well on new, previously unseen data.
exampleSentence: Strong model generalization meant performance barely dropped on the test set.
exampleTranslation: 出色的模型泛化能力意味着在测试集上的表现几乎没有下降。

englishDefinition: The method used to set a neural network's initial parameter values before training.
exampleSentence: Poor weight initialization made the network fail to learn anything in the first few epochs.
exampleTranslation: 不恰当的权重初始化导致网络在最初几轮训练中什么都学不到。

englishDefinition: A function applied to a neuron's output that introduces non-linearity into a network.
exampleSentence: Switching the activation function from sigmoid to ReLU sped up training considerably.
exampleTranslation: 把激活函数从 sigmoid 换成 ReLU 后，训练速度明显加快了。

englishDefinition: One complete pass through the entire training dataset during training.
exampleSentence: The model stopped improving noticeably after about twenty epochs.
exampleTranslation: 训练大约二十轮之后，模型的提升就不再明显了。

englishDefinition: The number of training examples processed together in one step of model training.
exampleSentence: A larger batch size sped up training but required more GPU memory.
exampleTranslation: 更大的批大小加快了训练速度，但也需要更多的 GPU 显存。

englishDefinition: A small subset of the training data used for a single gradient update step.
exampleSentence: Training on mini-batches was far more memory-efficient than using the full dataset at once.
exampleTranslation: 使用小批量进行训练，在内存效率上远高于一次性使用整个数据集。

englishDefinition: A neural network with many layers between the input and output.
exampleSentence: The deep neural network had over fifty layers, far more than early models used.
exampleTranslation: 这个深度神经网络有超过五十层，比早期模型的层数多得多。

englishDefinition: A neural network architecture especially effective for processing image data.
exampleSentence: A convolutional neural network powered the app's photo classification feature.
exampleTranslation: 一个卷积神经网络驱动了该应用的照片分类功能。

englishDefinition: A neural network architecture designed to process sequential data by maintaining a hidden state.
exampleSentence: The recurrent neural network struggled with very long sequences compared to newer architectures.
exampleTranslation: 与更新的架构相比，这个循环神经网络在处理超长序列时表现较差。

englishDefinition: A type of recurrent neural network designed to better capture long-range dependencies.
exampleSentence: Long short-term memory networks were the standard choice for sequence tasks before transformers.
exampleTranslation: 在 Transformer 出现之前，长短期记忆网络是序列任务的标准选择。

englishDefinition: A basic type of feedforward neural network with one or more hidden layers.
exampleSentence: A simple multilayer perceptron was enough to solve this small classification task.
exampleTranslation: 一个简单的多层感知机就足以解决这个小型分类任务。

englishDefinition: A regularization technique that randomly disables neurons during training to reduce overfitting.
exampleSentence: Adding dropout at a rate of 0.3 reduced overfitting without hurting accuracy much.
exampleTranslation: 加入丢弃率为 0.3 的随机失活后，过拟合减少了，而准确率几乎没有受到影响。

englishDefinition: A technique that normalizes layer inputs to stabilize and speed up training.
exampleSentence: Batch normalization let us use a much higher learning rate without the training diverging.
exampleTranslation: 批归一化让我们能够使用更高的学习率，同时训练也不会发散。

englishDefinition: A problem where gradients become too small to effectively update earlier layers during training.
exampleSentence: The vanishing gradient problem made the first few layers of the deep network barely learn anything.
exampleTranslation: 梯度消失问题让这个深度网络的前几层几乎学不到任何东西。

englishDefinition: A problem where gradients grow uncontrollably large, destabilizing training.
exampleSentence: Gradient clipping was added specifically to prevent exploding gradient during training.
exampleTranslation: 专门加入梯度裁剪就是为了防止训练过程中出现梯度爆炸。

englishDefinition: A shortcut connection that adds a layer's input directly to its output to ease training of deep networks.
exampleSentence: Residual connections made it possible to train networks with over a hundred layers.
exampleTranslation: 残差连接让训练超过一百层的网络成为了可能。

englishDefinition: A technique that lets a model focus on the most relevant parts of its input.
exampleSentence: The attention mechanism let the model focus on the relevant words when translating a long sentence.
exampleTranslation: 注意力机制让模型在翻译长句子时能够聚焦于相关的词语。

englishDefinition: An attention mechanism that relates different positions within a single sequence to each other.
exampleSentence: Self-attention let every word in the sentence directly attend to every other word.
exampleTranslation: 自注意力让句子中的每个词都能直接关注到其他所有词。

englishDefinition: A neural network trained to compress data and then reconstruct it as accurately as possible.
exampleSentence: The autoencoder learned to compress each image into a compact representation.
exampleTranslation: 这个自编码器学会了把每张图像压缩成一个紧凑的表示。

englishDefinition: A model architecture where a generator and a discriminator compete to improve each other.
exampleSentence: The generative adversarial network produced remarkably realistic synthetic faces.
exampleTranslation: 这个生成对抗网络生成的合成人脸相当逼真。

englishDefinition: A generative model that learns to produce data by reversing a gradual noising process.
exampleSentence: The diffusion model generated a high-quality image from pure random noise in fifty steps.
exampleTranslation: 这个扩散模型仅用五十步就从纯随机噪声生成了一张高质量图像。

englishDefinition: A compressed, learned representation of data where similar items are located close together.
exampleSentence: Moving smoothly through the latent space produced a smooth transition between two generated images.
exampleTranslation: 在潜在空间中平滑移动，产生了两张生成图像之间的平滑过渡效果。

englishDefinition: A network component that transforms raw input into a compressed internal representation.
exampleSentence: The encoder compressed the input sentence into a single fixed-length vector.
exampleTranslation: 编码器把输入句子压缩成了一个固定长度的向量。

englishDefinition: A network component that reconstructs or generates output from an internal representation.
exampleSentence: The decoder generated the translated sentence one word at a time.
exampleTranslation: 解码器逐词生成了翻译后的句子。

englishDefinition: A connection that bypasses one or more layers, feeding information directly to a later layer.
exampleSentence: The skip connection preserved fine details that would otherwise be lost in deeper layers.
exampleTranslation: 跳跃连接保留了那些原本会在更深的层中丢失的细节信息。

englishDefinition: A normalization technique applied across the features of a single training example.
exampleSentence: Layer normalization is used inside transformers instead of batch normalization.
exampleTranslation: Transformer 内部使用的是层归一化，而不是批归一化。

englishDefinition: A layer that reduces the spatial size of feature maps while retaining important information.
exampleSentence: The pooling layer cut the image resolution in half after each convolutional block.
exampleTranslation: 池化层在每个卷积模块之后都会把图像分辨率减半。

englishDefinition: The output of a convolutional layer, representing detected patterns at each spatial location.
exampleSentence: Visualizing the feature map showed the network had learned to detect edges early on.
exampleTranslation: 可视化特征图显示，网络在早期就已经学会了检测边缘。

englishDefinition: Using the same set of parameters across different parts of a network to reduce parameter count.
exampleSentence: Weight sharing across the convolutional filters kept the model small enough to run on mobile.
exampleTranslation: 卷积滤波器之间的权重共享让模型足够小，可以在手机上运行。

englishDefinition: The overall structure and design of layers and connections that make up a model.
exampleSentence: We tried three different model architectures before settling on the final design.
exampleTranslation: 我们尝试了三种不同的模型架构，才最终确定了最后的设计方案。

englishDefinition: A technique that caps gradient values to prevent them from becoming too large during training.
exampleSentence: Gradient clipping kept training stable even with a relatively high learning rate.
exampleTranslation: 即使学习率相对较高，梯度裁剪也让训练保持了稳定。

englishDefinition: The algorithm responsible for updating model weights based on computed gradients.
exampleSentence: Switching optimizers changed how quickly the model converged during training.
exampleTranslation: 更换优化器改变了模型在训练中收敛的速度。

englishDefinition: A popular optimization algorithm that adapts the learning rate for each parameter individually.
exampleSentence: The Adam optimizer converged faster than plain stochastic gradient descent on this task.
exampleTranslation: 在这个任务上，Adam 优化器的收敛速度比普通的随机梯度下降更快。

englishDefinition: A plan for how the learning rate changes over the course of training.
exampleSentence: A cosine learning rate schedule gradually lowered the rate as training progressed.
exampleTranslation: 余弦学习率调度策略随着训练的推进逐渐降低了学习率。

englishDefinition: A saved snapshot of a model's parameters at a specific point during training.
exampleSentence: We restored the best model checkpoint after the final few epochs made things worse.
exampleTranslation: 由于最后几轮训练反而让效果变差，我们恢复到了最优的模型检查点。

englishDefinition: Reusing a model trained on one task as the starting point for a related task.
exampleSentence: Transfer learning from a large pretrained model saved us weeks of training time.
exampleTranslation: 从一个大型预训练模型进行迁移学习，为我们节省了数周的训练时间。

englishDefinition: A model that has already been trained on a large dataset before being adapted for a new task.
exampleSentence: We started from a pretrained model instead of training from scratch.
exampleTranslation: 我们从一个预训练模型开始，而不是从零开始训练。

englishDefinition: A model where many parameters are zero or inactive, reducing computation and memory needs.
exampleSentence: The sparse model activated only a fraction of its parameters for any given input.
exampleTranslation: 这个稀疏模型对于任意给定输入，只会激活其参数中的一小部分。

englishDefinition: A technique where a smaller student model learns to mimic a larger teacher model.
exampleSentence: Knowledge distillation compressed the large model into one a fifth of its size.
exampleTranslation: 知识蒸馏把大模型压缩成了体积仅为其五分之一的小模型。

englishDefinition: An architecture that routes each input to a subset of specialized sub-networks called experts.
exampleSentence: The mixture of experts model activated only two experts out of sixty-four for each token.
exampleTranslation: 这个混合专家模型对每个 token 只会激活六十四个专家中的两个。

englishDefinition: An automated process for discovering high-performing neural network architectures.
exampleSentence: Neural architecture search found a model design that outperformed our hand-crafted one.
exampleTranslation: 神经架构搜索找到了一种性能超越我们手工设计模型的架构方案。

englishDefinition: A neural network trained on massive text data to understand and generate human language.
exampleSentence: The large language model could answer questions on almost any topic we tried.
exampleTranslation: 这个大语言模型几乎能回答我们尝试的任何主题的问题。

englishDefinition: The process of splitting text into smaller units, called tokens, for a model to process.
exampleSentence: Tokenization split the sentence into subword pieces rather than whole words.
exampleTranslation: 分词把这句话拆分成了子词单元，而不是完整的单词。

englishDefinition: A basic unit of text, such as a word or subword, that a language model processes.
exampleSentence: The prompt used about fifty tokens, well within the model's limit.
exampleTranslation: 这段提示词大约用了五十个词元，完全在模型的限制范围之内。

englishDefinition: The maximum amount of text a model can consider at once when generating a response.
exampleSentence: The document was too long to fit inside the model's context window.
exampleTranslation: 这份文档太长了，无法完整放入模型的上下文窗口。

englishDefinition: The input text given to a language model to guide its response.
exampleSentence: A more detailed prompt produced a much more useful answer.
exampleTranslation: 更详细的提示词得到了更有用的回答。

englishDefinition: The practice of designing prompts to get better, more reliable outputs from a language model.
exampleSentence: Prompt engineering turned a vague, unhelpful answer into a precise one.
exampleTranslation: 提示工程把一个模糊、没有帮助的回答变成了一个精准的答案。

englishDefinition: An instruction given to a language model that sets its behavior before the user's input.
exampleSentence: The system prompt told the model to always respond in a formal tone.
exampleTranslation: 系统提示词要求模型始终以正式的语气进行回应。

englishDefinition: Providing a model with a small number of examples within the prompt to guide its output.
exampleSentence: Few-shot learning with three examples was enough to get the formatting right.
exampleTranslation: 在提示词中给出三个示例的少样本学习，就足以让格式变得正确。

englishDefinition: Asking a model to perform a task without providing any examples in the prompt.
exampleSentence: Zero-shot learning worked surprisingly well for this common classification task.
exampleTranslation: 对于这个常见的分类任务，零样本学习的效果出乎意料地好。

englishDefinition: A model's ability to learn a task from examples given directly in the prompt, without retraining.
exampleSentence: In-context learning let the model pick up a new format just from the examples shown.
exampleTranslation: 上下文学习让模型仅通过给出的示例就学会了一种新的格式。

englishDefinition: A prompting technique that asks a model to reason step by step before giving a final answer.
exampleSentence: Chain of thought prompting made the model much more accurate on multi-step math problems.
exampleTranslation: 思维链提示让模型在多步数学问题上的准确率大幅提升。

englishDefinition: A sampling parameter that controls how random or deterministic a model's output is.
exampleSentence: Lowering the temperature made the model's answers more consistent across runs.
exampleTranslation: 降低温度参数让模型在多次运行中的回答更加一致。

englishDefinition: A sampling method that selects from the smallest set of tokens whose combined probability exceeds p.
exampleSentence: Top-p sampling produced more natural text than always picking the single most likely token.
exampleTranslation: Top-p 采样生成的文本比总是选择概率最高的那个词元更自然。

englishDefinition: A sampling method that restricts token selection to the k most likely candidates.
exampleSentence: Top-k sampling with a small k value made the output more focused but less creative.
exampleTranslation: 较小 k 值的 Top-k 采样让输出更聚焦，但创造性有所下降。

englishDefinition: A decoding strategy that keeps track of multiple candidate sequences to find a high-probability output.
exampleSentence: Beam search produced a more coherent translation than greedy decoding did.
exampleTranslation: 束搜索生成的翻译比贪婪解码更连贯。

englishDefinition: A decoding strategy that always picks the single most likely next token.
exampleSentence: Greedy decoding was fast but sometimes got stuck in repetitive loops.
exampleTranslation: 贪婪解码速度很快，但有时会陷入重复循环。

chineseMeaning: 幻觉（AI 生成虚假内容）
englishDefinition: When a model generates confident but factually incorrect or fabricated information.
exampleSentence: The model's hallucination invented a citation that didn't actually exist.
exampleTranslation: 模型的幻觉编造出了一篇实际上并不存在的引用文献。

englishDefinition: Fine-tuning a model on examples of instructions and desired responses to improve its helpfulness.
exampleSentence: Instruction tuning made the model far better at following explicit user requests.
exampleTranslation: 指令微调让模型在遵循用户明确请求方面表现好了很多。

chineseMeaning: 基于人类反馈的强化学习
englishDefinition: A training technique that uses human preference data to further align a model's behavior.
exampleSentence: Reinforcement learning from human feedback made the assistant's tone noticeably more helpful.
exampleTranslation: 基于人类反馈的强化学习让这个助手的语气明显变得更有帮助了。

englishDefinition: A model trained to score outputs based on how well they match human preferences.
exampleSentence: The reward model was trained on thousands of human comparisons between two responses.
exampleTranslation: 这个奖励模型是基于数千次人类对两个回答进行比较的数据训练出来的。

englishDefinition: Making a model's behavior match human intentions and values.
exampleSentence: Alignment work focused on making the model refuse harmful requests consistently.
exampleTranslation: 对齐工作的重点是让模型能够始终如一地拒绝有害请求。

englishDefinition: A training approach that uses a set of written principles to guide a model's self-critique and revision.
exampleSentence: Constitutional AI let the model critique and revise its own draft answers automatically.
exampleTranslation: 宪法式 AI 让模型能够自动地对自己的初稿答案进行批判和修正。

englishDefinition: The number of tokens a model can process as input at one time.
exampleSentence: Doubling the context length let the model read the entire report in one pass.
exampleTranslation: 把上下文长度翻倍后，模型可以一次性读完整份报告。

englishDefinition: A model that generates output one token at a time, each based on the tokens before it.
exampleSentence: As an autoregressive model, it generated the response word by word from left to right.
exampleTranslation: 作为一个自回归模型，它从左到右逐词生成回答。

englishDefinition: The core training objective where a model learns to predict the next token in a sequence.
exampleSentence: Next token prediction on massive text corpora is how most language models are pretrained.
exampleTranslation: 在海量文本语料上进行下一词元预测，是大多数语言模型预训练的方式。

englishDefinition: A technique that gives a transformer information about the order of tokens in a sequence.
exampleSentence: Positional encoding let the model tell the difference between "dog bites man" and "man bites dog."
exampleTranslation: 位置编码让模型能够区分"狗咬人"和"人咬狗"这两句话。

englishDefinition: An attention mechanism that runs several attention operations in parallel to capture different relationships.
exampleSentence: Multi-head attention let the model track grammar and meaning at the same time.
exampleTranslation: 多头注意力让模型能够同时关注语法和语义。

englishDefinition: The learned numerical parameters that define a trained model's behavior.
exampleSentence: Downloading the model weights took over an hour because the file was so large.
exampleTranslation: 由于文件体积巨大，下载模型权重花了一个多小时。

englishDefinition: The total number of learnable weights in a model, often used as a rough measure of its size.
exampleSentence: The parameter count jumped from one billion to seventy billion in the newer version.
exampleTranslation: 在新版本中，参数量从十亿跃升到了七百亿。

englishDefinition: A model whose trained parameters are publicly released for others to download and run.
exampleSentence: We fine-tuned an open-weight model instead of relying on a closed API.
exampleTranslation: 我们对一个开放权重模型进行了微调，而不是依赖一个封闭的 API。

englishDefinition: A document that describes a model's intended use, limitations, and training details.
exampleSentence: The model card listed the languages the model had been evaluated on.
exampleTranslation: 模型卡片列出了该模型经过评估的语言种类。

englishDefinition: An attempt to bypass a model's safety restrictions through crafted prompts.
exampleSentence: The security team tested for jailbreak attempts before the assistant was released publicly.
exampleTranslation: 安全团队在助手正式公开发布之前测试了各种越狱尝试。

englishDefinition: An attack that embeds malicious instructions within input text to manipulate a model's behavior.
exampleSentence: Prompt injection hidden in a webpage tricked the agent into leaking data.
exampleTranslation: 隐藏在网页中的提示词注入诱使智能体泄露了数据。

englishDefinition: A message that sets context or instructions for a model before the conversation begins.
exampleSentence: The system message specified the assistant's name and area of expertise.
exampleTranslation: 系统消息指定了这个助手的名称和专业领域。

englishDefinition: The text a language model generates in response to a given prompt.
exampleSentence: The completion matched the requested format almost perfectly.
exampleTranslation: 这个补全结果几乎完美地符合了要求的格式。

englishDefinition: The subfield of NLP focused on extracting meaning and intent from human language.
exampleSentence: Natural language understanding let the system correctly interpret ambiguous customer questions.
exampleTranslation: 自然语言理解让系统能够正确理解客户提出的模糊问题。

englishDefinition: The subfield of NLP focused on producing human-readable text from structured data or models.
exampleSentence: Natural language generation turned the raw sales numbers into a readable summary.
exampleTranslation: 自然语言生成把原始的销售数字转换成了一段可读的摘要。

englishDefinition: The task of identifying and classifying names of people, places, or organizations in text.
exampleSentence: Named entity recognition pulled every company name out of the earnings call transcript.
exampleTranslation: 命名实体识别从这份财报电话会议记录中提取出了所有公司名称。

englishDefinition: The task of labeling each word in a sentence with its grammatical role.
exampleSentence: Part-of-speech tagging identified which words were verbs before the parser ran.
exampleTranslation: 词性标注在句法分析器运行之前先识别出了哪些词是动词。

englishDefinition: The task of determining the emotional tone expressed in a piece of text.
exampleSentence: Sentiment analysis flagged a sharp rise in negative reviews after the price increase.
exampleTranslation: 情感分析发现涨价后负面评价明显增多。

englishDefinition: The task of assigning predefined categories to a piece of text.
exampleSentence: Text classification automatically routed support tickets to the right department.
exampleTranslation: 文本分类自动把客服工单分派到了正确的部门。

englishDefinition: The task of producing a shorter version of a text that preserves its key information.
exampleSentence: Text summarization condensed the fifty-page report into a single readable page.
exampleTranslation: 文本摘要把这份五十页的报告浓缩成了一页可读的内容。

englishDefinition: The task of automatically translating text from one language to another.
exampleSentence: Machine translation quality has improved dramatically since neural models replaced older methods.
exampleTranslation: 自从神经网络模型取代了旧方法，机器翻译的质量有了显著提升。

englishDefinition: A task where a system provides direct answers to natural language questions.
exampleSentence: The question answering system pulled the exact answer straight from the manual.
exampleTranslation: 这个问答系统直接从说明书中提取出了准确答案。

englishDefinition: The task of determining which words in a text refer to the same real-world entity.
exampleSentence: Coreference resolution correctly linked "she" back to "the CEO" mentioned two sentences earlier.
exampleTranslation: 指代消解正确地把"她"和两句之前提到的"首席执行官"关联了起来。

englishDefinition: The task of analyzing the grammatical structure of a sentence to show relationships between words.
exampleSentence: Dependency parsing showed that "quickly" modified the verb "ran," not the noun.
exampleTranslation: 依存句法分析显示"quickly"修饰的是动词"ran"，而不是名词。

englishDefinition: A dense numerical vector representation of a word that captures aspects of its meaning.
exampleSentence: The word embedding for "king" ended up mathematically close to the embedding for "queen."
exampleTranslation: "king"的词嵌入在数学上与"queen"的词嵌入非常接近。

englishDefinition: A simple text representation that counts word occurrences while ignoring order and grammar.
exampleSentence: A bag of words model was a fast baseline before we tried anything more sophisticated.
exampleTranslation: 在尝试更复杂的方法之前，词袋模型是一个快速的基线方案。

englishDefinition: A statistic that measures how important a word is to a document within a larger collection.
exampleSentence: TF-IDF down-weighted common words like "the" that appeared in nearly every document.
exampleTranslation: 词频-逆文档频率降低了像"the"这类几乎出现在每份文档中的常见词的权重。

englishDefinition: A contiguous sequence of n words or tokens used to model local language patterns.
exampleSentence: The n-gram model captured common two-word phrases but missed longer-range context.
exampleTranslation: 这个 N 元语法模型能捕捉常见的双词短语，但会遗漏更长距离的上下文关系。

englishDefinition: Reducing words to their root form by stripping suffixes, often crudely.
exampleSentence: Stemming reduced "running," "runs," and "runner" all down to "run."
exampleTranslation: 词干提取把"running"、"runs"和"runner"都简化成了"run"。

englishDefinition: Reducing words to their dictionary base form using vocabulary and grammar rules.
exampleSentence: Lemmatization correctly reduced "better" to "good," unlike simple stemming.
exampleTranslation: 与简单的词干提取不同，词形还原正确地把"better"还原成了"good"。

englishDefinition: Common words like "the" or "is" that are often filtered out before text analysis.
exampleSentence: Removing stop words shrank the vocabulary size by nearly half.
exampleTranslation: 去除停用词后，词表规模减少了近一半。

englishDefinition: A large, structured collection of text used for training or analyzing language models.
exampleSentence: The corpus contained over ten million sentences scraped from public documents.
exampleTranslation: 这个语料库包含了从公开文档中抓取的超过一千万个句子。

englishDefinition: A model trained to predict or generate text based on patterns learned from language data.
exampleSentence: An early language model could only predict the next word based on the previous two.
exampleTranslation: 早期的语言模型只能根据前两个词来预测下一个词。

englishDefinition: A measure of how close two pieces of text are in meaning.
exampleSentence: Semantic similarity matched the customer question to a support article even without shared keywords.
exampleTranslation: 即使没有相同的关键词，语义相似度也能把客户问题匹配到对应的帮助文档。

englishDefinition: The process of converting text into a consistent, standard format before processing.
exampleSentence: Text normalization lowercased and removed extra punctuation before tokenization.
exampleTranslation: 文本规范化在分词之前把文本转成了小写并去除了多余的标点符号。

englishDefinition: The task of connecting a mentioned entity in text to its corresponding record in a knowledge base.
exampleSentence: Entity linking connected "Apple" in the article to the correct company, not the fruit.
exampleTranslation: 实体链接把文章中的"Apple"正确地关联到了对应的公司，而不是水果。

englishDefinition: A technique for discovering abstract topics that occur across a collection of documents.
exampleSentence: Topic modeling revealed that customer complaints clustered around three recurring themes.
exampleTranslation: 主题建模揭示出客户投诉集中在三个反复出现的主题上。

englishDefinition: The task of determining which meaning of a word is intended given its context.
exampleSentence: Word sense disambiguation figured out that "bank" referred to a riverbank, not a financial institution.
exampleTranslation: 词义消歧判断出"bank"在这里指的是河岸，而不是金融机构。

englishDefinition: The task of assigning a label to each element in a sequence, such as each word in a sentence.
exampleSentence: Sequence labeling tagged each token in the resume as a skill, company, or date.
exampleTranslation: 序列标注给简历中的每个词元都打上了技能、公司或日期的标签。

englishDefinition: The technology that converts written text into spoken audio.
exampleSentence: Text-to-speech read the article aloud in a natural-sounding voice.
exampleTranslation: 文本转语音以一种自然的声音朗读了这篇文章。

englishDefinition: The technology that converts spoken audio into written text.
exampleSentence: Speech-to-text transcribed the entire hour-long meeting in real time.
exampleTranslation: 语音转文本实时转录了这场长达一小时的会议。

englishDefinition: A system designed to converse with users in natural language, such as a chatbot.
exampleSentence: The dialogue system remembered context from earlier in the conversation.
exampleTranslation: 这个对话系统能够记住对话中较早部分的上下文。

englishDefinition: The task of identifying what a user is trying to achieve from their input text.
exampleSentence: Intent classification routed the message to "cancel order" instead of "track order."
exampleTranslation: 意图分类把这条消息归类为"取消订单"，而不是"查询订单"。

englishDefinition: The task of extracting specific pieces of structured information from a user's natural language input.
exampleSentence: Slot filling extracted the date, time, and party size from a single reservation request.
exampleTranslation: 槽位填充从一条预订请求中提取出了日期、时间和用餐人数。

englishDefinition: A model trained to understand or generate text across multiple languages.
exampleSentence: The multilingual model handled customer support in twelve languages with one deployment.
exampleTranslation: 这个多语言模型通过一次部署就能处理十二种语言的客户支持。

englishDefinition: The fixed set of tokens a tokenizer can produce when splitting text.
exampleSentence: The tokenizer vocabulary had thirty thousand entries covering common subwords across languages.
exampleTranslation: 这个分词器词表包含三万个条目，涵盖了多种语言的常见子词。

englishDefinition: Splitting words into smaller, reusable pieces to handle rare or unseen words.
exampleSentence: Subword tokenization split the unfamiliar word into two recognizable pieces.
exampleTranslation: 子词分词把这个生僻词拆分成了两个可识别的部分。

englishDefinition: The process of analyzing the grammatical structure of a sentence.
exampleSentence: Syntactic parsing built a tree showing how each phrase in the sentence related to the others.
exampleTranslation: 句法解析构建了一棵树，展示了句中每个短语之间的关系。

englishDefinition: The task of assigning a single label to an entire image based on its content.
exampleSentence: Image classification correctly labeled ninety-eight percent of the test photos as cats or dogs.
exampleTranslation: 图像分类正确标注了 98% 的测试照片，判断出图中是猫还是狗。

englishDefinition: The task of locating and classifying multiple objects within an image.
exampleSentence: Object detection drew a box around every car and pedestrian in the street scene.
exampleTranslation: 目标检测在这张街景图中的每辆车和每个行人周围都画出了框。

englishDefinition: The task of labeling every pixel in an image with the category of object it belongs to.
exampleSentence: Semantic segmentation separated the road, sidewalk, and sky into distinct regions.
exampleTranslation: 语义分割把道路、人行道和天空分成了不同的区域。

englishDefinition: The task of detecting and outlining each individual object instance separately in an image.
exampleSentence: Instance segmentation distinguished between three different people standing close together.
exampleTranslation: 实例分割区分出了三个站得很近的不同的人。

englishDefinition: The task of creating new images, often from a text description or random input.
exampleSentence: Image generation produced a realistic photo from nothing but a short text prompt.
exampleTranslation: 图像生成仅凭一段简短的文字提示，就生成了一张逼真的照片。

englishDefinition: The technology that converts images of text into machine-readable text.
exampleSentence: Optical character recognition extracted the invoice number from a scanned PDF.
exampleTranslation: 光学字符识别从一份扫描版 PDF 中提取出了发票号码。

englishDefinition: The technology that identifies or verifies a person based on their facial features.
exampleSentence: Facial recognition unlocked the phone in under a second.
exampleTranslation: 人脸识别在不到一秒钟内就解锁了手机。

englishDefinition: The task of predicting the position of a person's body joints from an image or video.
exampleSentence: Pose estimation tracked the athlete's joint angles throughout the jump.
exampleTranslation: 姿态估计在整个跳跃过程中追踪了运动员的关节角度。

englishDefinition: A rectangular box that marks the location of a detected object in an image.
exampleSentence: Each bounding box was labeled with the object's class and confidence score.
exampleTranslation: 每个边界框都标注了对象的类别和置信度分数。

englishDefinition: A predefined reference box used by object detection models to predict object locations.
exampleSentence: The model used nine anchor boxes of different sizes at every location in the image.
exampleTranslation: 该模型在图像的每个位置都使用了九种不同尺寸的锚框。

englishDefinition: A technique that removes duplicate, overlapping detections and keeps only the best one.
exampleSentence: Non-maximum suppression removed the five overlapping boxes drawn around the same car.
exampleTranslation: 非极大值抑制去除了围绕同一辆车画出的五个重叠框。

englishDefinition: A metric that measures the overlap between a predicted region and the ground truth region.
exampleSentence: An intersection over union above 0.5 was required for a detection to count as correct.
exampleTranslation: 交并比需要超过 0.5，检测结果才算正确。

englishDefinition: A multi-scale representation of an image used to detect objects of different sizes.
exampleSentence: The feature pyramid helped the model detect both tiny and large objects in the same image.
exampleTranslation: 特征金字塔帮助模型在同一张图像中同时检测出微小和巨大的物体。

englishDefinition: Techniques that create modified copies of training images to improve model robustness.
exampleSentence: Image augmentation randomly rotated and flipped photos to expand the training set.
exampleTranslation: 图像增强通过随机旋转和翻转照片来扩充训练集。

englishDefinition: A small matrix of weights slid across an image to detect specific visual patterns.
exampleSentence: Each convolution kernel in the first layer learned to detect a different type of edge.
exampleTranslation: 第一层中的每个卷积核都学会了检测一种不同类型的边缘。

englishDefinition: The number of pixels a convolution kernel moves at each step across an image.
exampleSentence: Increasing the stride reduced the output size and sped up computation.
exampleTranslation: 增大步幅缩小了输出尺寸，也加快了计算速度。

englishDefinition: The region of the input image that influences a particular neuron's output.
exampleSentence: Deeper layers had a much larger receptive field, capturing more global context.
exampleTranslation: 更深的层拥有更大的感受野，能够捕捉到更多全局的上下文信息。

englishDefinition: A transformer-based architecture adapted to process images by treating patches as tokens.
exampleSentence: The vision transformer split each image into sixteen-by-sixteen pixel patches.
exampleTranslation: 这个视觉 Transformer 把每张图像切分成了 16x16 像素的图像块。

englishDefinition: The task of automatically generating a text description of an image's contents.
exampleSentence: Image captioning described the photo as "a dog running on a beach at sunset."
exampleTranslation: 图像描述生成把这张照片描述为"一只狗在日落时分的海滩上奔跑"。

englishDefinition: The task of extracting meaning, actions, or events from video content.
exampleSentence: Video understanding flagged the moment a package was left at the door.
exampleTranslation: 视频理解识别出了包裹被放在门口的那一刻。

englishDefinition: The pattern of apparent motion of objects between two consecutive video frames.
exampleSentence: Optical flow estimated how fast and in which direction each car was moving.
exampleTranslation: 光流估算出了每辆车移动的速度和方向。

englishDefinition: The task of predicting the distance of objects in a scene from a single camera image.
exampleSentence: Depth estimation let the robot judge how far away the obstacle was.
exampleTranslation: 深度估计让机器人能够判断障碍物的距离。

englishDefinition: The task of reconstructing a high-resolution image from a lower-resolution input.
exampleSentence: Image super-resolution restored fine detail in the old, blurry photograph.
exampleTranslation: 图像超分辨率技术在这张模糊的老照片中恢复出了精细的细节。

englishDefinition: A technique that applies the visual style of one image to the content of another.
exampleSentence: Style transfer turned the photograph into something that looked like a watercolor painting.
exampleTranslation: 风格迁移把这张照片变成了看起来像水彩画的效果。

englishDefinition: The task of identifying data points or images that deviate significantly from the norm.
exampleSentence: Anomaly detection flagged a manufacturing defect the human inspector had missed.
exampleTranslation: 异常检测发现了一处人工检查员遗漏的制造缺陷。

englishDefinition: The task of interpreting the overall context and layout of a visual scene.
exampleSentence: Scene understanding recognized the image as an office rather than just listing individual objects.
exampleTranslation: 场景理解把这张图像识别为一间办公室，而不只是罗列出其中的各个物体。

englishDefinition: A task that combines semantic and instance segmentation to label every pixel and object.
exampleSentence: Panoptic segmentation labeled the sky as one region and each car as a separate instance.
exampleTranslation: 全景分割把天空标注为一个整体区域，同时把每辆车标注为单独的实例。

englishDefinition: The task of following multiple objects across consecutive video frames over time.
exampleSentence: Multi-object tracking kept a consistent ID on each player throughout the match.
exampleTranslation: 多目标跟踪在整场比赛中为每名球员保持了一致的编号。

englishDefinition: The task of locating specific, predefined points of interest within an image, such as joints.
exampleSentence: Keypoint detection identified the exact position of each finger joint in the hand.
exampleTranslation: 关键点检测精确定位出了手部每个指关节的位置。

englishDefinition: A dense numerical vector representation that captures the visual content of an image.
exampleSentence: Similar-looking products ended up close together in the image embedding space.
exampleTranslation: 外观相似的商品在图像嵌入空间中会彼此靠得很近。

englishDefinition: A training approach that teaches a model to pull similar examples together and push dissimilar ones apart.
exampleSentence: Contrastive learning taught the model that two crops of the same photo should have similar embeddings.
exampleTranslation: 对比学习让模型学会了同一张照片的两个裁剪片段应该拥有相似的嵌入表示。

englishDefinition: Pretraining a model on unlabeled data using a task the model can generate labels for itself.
exampleSentence: Self-supervised pretraining on millions of unlabeled photos improved downstream accuracy.
exampleTranslation: 在数百万张未标注照片上进行的自监督预训练，提升了下游任务的准确率。

englishDefinition: A configured sequence of transformations applied automatically to training data.
exampleSentence: The data augmentation pipeline applied random crops, flips, and color jitter to every image.
exampleTranslation: 数据增强流水线对每张图像都应用了随机裁剪、翻转和色彩抖动。

englishDefinition: Steps taken to prepare raw images for input into a model, such as resizing or normalizing.
exampleSentence: Image preprocessing resized every photo to the same fixed dimensions before training.
exampleTranslation: 图像预处理在训练之前把每张照片都调整成了相同的固定尺寸。

englishDefinition: Errors or inaccuracies present in the labels of a training dataset.
exampleSentence: Label noise from crowdsourced annotators lowered the model's final accuracy.
exampleTranslation: 来自众包标注人员的标签噪声降低了模型最终的准确率。

englishDefinition: Fine-tuning a pretrained model on labeled examples for a specific task.
exampleSentence: Supervised fine-tuning on customer support transcripts made the model far more useful for our use case.
exampleTranslation: 在客服对话记录上进行的监督微调，让模型对我们的场景更加有用。

englishDefinition: Fine-tuning techniques that update only a small subset of a model's parameters.
exampleSentence: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning let us adapt the model using a fraction of the usual compute.
exampleTranslation: 参数高效微调让我们只用平常一小部分的算力就完成了模型适配。

englishDefinition: A parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that adds small trainable low-rank matrices to a model.
exampleSentence: LoRA let us fine-tune the huge model on a single GPU instead of a whole cluster.
exampleTranslation: LoRA 让我们能在单张 GPU 上完成对这个巨大模型的微调，而不需要整个集群。

englishDefinition: Reducing the numerical precision of model weights to save memory and speed up inference.
exampleSentence: Quantization shrank the model to a quarter of its original size with minimal accuracy loss.
exampleTranslation: 量化把模型压缩到了原来大小的四分之一，而准确率几乎没有下降。

englishDefinition: Techniques used to reduce a model's size while preserving as much performance as possible.
exampleSentence: Model compression made it possible to run the assistant directly on a smartphone.
exampleTranslation: 模型压缩让这个助手能够直接在智能手机上运行。

englishDefinition: Removing unnecessary weights or connections from a neural network to reduce its size.
exampleSentence: Pruning removed forty percent of the weights without noticeably hurting accuracy.
exampleTranslation: 剪枝去除了 40% 的权重，而准确率没有明显下降。

englishDefinition: A training strategy that presents examples to a model in order of increasing difficulty.
exampleSentence: Curriculum learning started with short sentences before gradually introducing longer, harder ones.
exampleTranslation: 课程学习从短句子开始，再逐步引入更长、更难的句子。

englishDefinition: An initial training period where the learning rate is gradually increased from a small value.
exampleSentence: Adding warm-up steps prevented the loss from spiking at the very start of training.
exampleTranslation: 加入预热步数避免了损失值在训练最开始出现骤增。

englishDefinition: A technique that simulates a larger batch size by accumulating gradients over several smaller batches.
exampleSentence: Gradient accumulation let us train with an effective batch size larger than our GPU memory allowed.
exampleTranslation: 梯度累积让我们能够以超出 GPU 显存限制的有效批大小进行训练。

englishDefinition: Training a model across multiple machines or devices simultaneously to speed up the process.
exampleSentence: Distributed training across sixty-four GPUs cut the training time from weeks to days.
exampleTranslation: 在六十四张 GPU 上进行的分布式训练，把训练时间从几周缩短到了几天。

englishDefinition: A distributed training strategy that splits training data across multiple devices running the same model.
exampleSentence: Data parallelism let each GPU process a different batch of the same dataset simultaneously.
exampleTranslation: 数据并行让每张 GPU 能同时处理同一数据集的不同批次。

englishDefinition: A distributed training strategy that splits a single model's layers across multiple devices.
exampleSentence: Model parallelism was necessary because the model was too large to fit on one GPU.
exampleTranslation: 由于模型太大，单张 GPU 无法容纳，因此需要使用模型并行。

englishDefinition: Training that uses lower numerical precision for some calculations to speed up training and save memory.
exampleSentence: Mixed precision training roughly doubled our training throughput.
exampleTranslation: 混合精度训练让我们的训练吞吐量大致提高了一倍。

englishDefinition: Restarting training from a saved checkpoint rather than from scratch.
exampleSentence: Checkpoint resume let us continue training right where it stopped after the server crashed.
exampleTranslation: 断点续训让我们能在服务器崩溃后，从中断的地方继续训练。

englishDefinition: Halting training once validation performance stops improving, to avoid overfitting.
exampleSentence: Early stopping ended training after five epochs with no further improvement.
exampleTranslation: 早停法在连续五轮训练没有进一步提升后，就结束了训练。

englishDefinition: A plot of a model's loss on the training set over the course of training.
exampleSentence: The training loss curve showed a smooth, steady decline with no sudden spikes.
exampleTranslation: 训练损失曲线呈现出平稳、持续的下降，没有出现突然的波动。

englishDefinition: A measure of a model's error on a held-out validation dataset during training.
exampleSentence: Validation loss started increasing even as training loss kept dropping, a clear sign of overfitting.
exampleTranslation: 验证损失开始上升，而训练损失仍在下降，这是过拟合的明显信号。

englishDefinition: The process of searching for the best combination of hyperparameters for a model.
exampleSentence: Hyperparameter tuning improved accuracy by two full percentage points.
exampleTranslation: 超参数调优让准确率提高了整整两个百分点。

englishDefinition: A hyperparameter tuning method that exhaustively tries every combination in a predefined set.
exampleSentence: Grid search across three parameters took almost a full day to complete.
exampleTranslation: 对三个参数进行的网格搜索花了将近一整天才完成。

englishDefinition: A hyperparameter tuning method that samples random combinations rather than testing every one.
exampleSentence: Random search found a good configuration faster than grid search did.
exampleTranslation: 随机搜索比网格搜索更快地找到了一个不错的配置。

englishDefinition: A hyperparameter tuning method that uses past results to intelligently choose the next configuration to try.
exampleSentence: Bayesian optimization found a strong hyperparameter setting in a fraction of the trials grid search needed.
exampleTranslation: 贝叶斯优化只用了网格搜索所需试验次数的一小部分，就找到了一组不错的超参数配置。

englishDefinition: The full sequence of automated steps used to prepare data and train a model.
exampleSentence: The training pipeline handled data loading, augmentation, training, and evaluation automatically.
exampleTranslation: 这套训练流水线自动完成了数据加载、增强、训练和评估的全过程。

englishDefinition: A component that efficiently feeds batches of training data to a model during training.
exampleSentence: A faster data loader eliminated the GPU idle time we were seeing between batches.
exampleTranslation: 更快的数据加载器消除了我们此前在批次之间观察到的 GPU 空闲时间。

englishDefinition: Creating artificial training data, often using another model, to supplement real data.
exampleSentence: Synthetic data generation filled the gap where real labeled examples were scarce.
exampleTranslation: 合成数据生成弥补了真实标注样本稀缺的空缺。

englishDefinition: Adapting a model trained on one data domain to perform well on a different but related domain.
exampleSentence: Domain adaptation helped the model trained on news articles perform well on medical text.
exampleTranslation: 领域自适应帮助这个在新闻文章上训练的模型，在医学文本上也能表现良好。

englishDefinition: A problem where a model loses previously learned knowledge while learning a new task.
exampleSentence: Catastrophic forgetting erased the model's general knowledge after narrow fine-tuning.
exampleTranslation: 灾难性遗忘在经过狭窄领域的微调后，抹去了模型原有的通用知识。

englishDefinition: A model's ability to learn new tasks over time without forgetting previously learned ones.
exampleSentence: Continual learning let the model pick up new product categories without retraining from scratch.
exampleTranslation: 持续学习让模型能够学习新的产品类别，而无需从头重新训练。

englishDefinition: A training approach where the model selects the most informative examples for humans to label next.
exampleSentence: Active learning cut labeling costs in half by focusing annotators on the most uncertain examples.
exampleTranslation: 主动学习让标注人员专注于模型最不确定的样本，从而把标注成本降低了一半。

englishDefinition: Training a model using noisy, imprecise, or programmatically generated labels instead of hand-labeled data.
exampleSentence: Weak supervision let us generate rough labels for a million examples in a single afternoon.
exampleTranslation: 弱监督让我们在一个下午内就为一百万个样本生成了粗略的标签。

englishDefinition: A regularization technique that softens hard labels to prevent a model from becoming overconfident.
exampleSentence: Label smoothing made the model's confidence scores more realistic and better calibrated.
exampleTranslation: 标签平滑让模型的置信度分数变得更加真实、校准得更好。

englishDefinition: A training setup where a smaller student model learns from the outputs of a larger teacher model.
exampleSentence: Teacher-student training let the small model match much of the teacher's accuracy.
exampleTranslation: 师生训练让这个小模型达到了与教师模型相近的准确率。

englishDefinition: The specific task, such as predicting masked words, that a model optimizes during pretraining.
exampleSentence: The pretraining objective was to predict the next token given everything before it.
exampleTranslation: 这个预训练目标是根据前面的所有内容来预测下一个词元。

englishDefinition: A pretraining objective where a model learns to predict randomly hidden words in a sentence.
exampleSentence: Masked language modeling hid fifteen percent of the words for the model to predict.
exampleTranslation: 掩码语言建模隐藏了句子中 15% 的词，让模型去预测它们。

englishDefinition: Pretraining a model using a contrastive objective that distinguishes similar from dissimilar examples.
exampleSentence: Contrastive pretraining on image-text pairs taught the model to match captions to the right photos.
exampleTranslation: 在图文对上进行的对比预训练，教会了模型将描述文字与正确的照片匹配起来。

englishDefinition: Erratic or divergent behavior in loss values during model training.
exampleSentence: Training instability at large scale required careful tuning of the learning rate and batch size.
exampleTranslation: 大规模训练中的训练不稳定问题，需要对学习率和批大小进行细致的调整。

englishDefinition: The process of using a trained model to generate predictions on new input data.
exampleSentence: Model inference ran in under a hundred milliseconds per request.
exampleTranslation: 模型推理每次请求的耗时都在一百毫秒以内。

englishDefinition: The amount of time it takes a model to produce an output after receiving an input.
exampleSentence: Inference latency dropped by half after we switched to a quantized model.
exampleTranslation: 切换到量化模型后，推理延迟降低了一半。

englishDefinition: The number of requests or tokens a model can process within a given time period.
exampleSentence: Inference throughput doubled once we started batching requests together.
exampleTranslation: 在开始批量处理请求之后，推理吞吐量提高了一倍。

englishDefinition: Processing many inputs together in a single pass rather than one at a time.
exampleSentence: Batch inference on the full dataset finished overnight instead of taking days.
exampleTranslation: 对整个数据集进行的批量推理只用一夜就完成了，而不是花上好几天。

englishDefinition: Generating model predictions with minimal delay, suitable for interactive applications.
exampleSentence: Real-time inference was essential for the live voice assistant to feel responsive.
exampleTranslation: 实时推理对于这个实时语音助手要有响应速度感至关重要。

englishDefinition: Running model inference directly on a local device rather than a remote server.
exampleSentence: Edge inference on the camera itself meant no footage ever left the building.
exampleTranslation: 在摄像头本地进行边缘推理，意味着画面数据从未离开过大楼。

englishDefinition: A dedicated server or service optimized to run model predictions for incoming requests.
exampleSentence: The inference server autoscaled to handle the spike in traffic during the product launch.
exampleTranslation: 这个推理服务器在产品发布期间的流量高峰中实现了自动扩缩容。

englishDefinition: The infrastructure and practices used to make a trained model available for inference requests.
exampleSentence: Model serving through a standard API let every internal team use the same model.
exampleTranslation: 通过标准 API 进行的模型服务化，让公司内部每个团队都能使用同一个模型。

englishDefinition: A cache of previously computed attention keys and values used to speed up autoregressive generation.
exampleSentence: The KV cache avoided recomputing attention for tokens that had already been generated.
exampleTranslation: KV 缓存避免了对已经生成过的词元重新计算注意力。

englishDefinition: A technique that uses a small, fast model to draft tokens which a larger model then verifies.
exampleSentence: Speculative decoding roughly doubled the generation speed without changing the output quality.
exampleTranslation: 推测解码在不改变输出质量的前提下，把生成速度大致提高了一倍。

englishDefinition: Running model inference using reduced numerical precision to save memory and increase speed.
exampleSentence: Quantized inference let the model run on a laptop instead of requiring a data center GPU.
exampleTranslation: 量化推理让这个模型能够在笔记本电脑上运行，而不再需要数据中心级别的 GPU。

englishDefinition: Techniques applied to reduce the cost or latency of running a model in production.
exampleSentence: Inference optimization cut our monthly serving costs by a third.
exampleTranslation: 推理优化让我们每月的服务成本降低了三分之一。

englishDefinition: Converting a trained model into an optimized format for faster execution on specific hardware.
exampleSentence: Model compilation for the target GPU improved throughput without any accuracy loss.
exampleTranslation: 针对目标 GPU 进行的模型编译在不损失准确率的情况下提升了吞吐量。

englishDefinition: A cross-platform engine for running models exported in the ONNX format efficiently.
exampleSentence: ONNX runtime let us deploy the same model across web, mobile, and server without rewriting it.
exampleTranslation: ONNX 运行时让我们能够在网页、移动端和服务器上部署同一个模型，而无需重写代码。

englishDefinition: A URL or interface through which applications send requests to a deployed model.
exampleSentence: The inference endpoint returned a prediction within two hundred milliseconds.
exampleTranslation: 这个推理接口能在两百毫秒内返回预测结果。

englishDefinition: Returning a model's generated text incrementally as it's produced, rather than all at once.
exampleSentence: Streaming output let users see the response appear word by word instead of waiting.
exampleTranslation: 流式输出让用户能够逐词看到回答的生成过程，而不需要等待完整结果。

englishDefinition: The rate at which a language model produces output tokens, often measured per second.
exampleSentence: Token generation speed reached forty tokens per second on the new hardware.
exampleTranslation: 在新硬件上，词元生成速度达到了每秒四十个词元。

englishDefinition: The monetary or computational cost associated with running a model to generate predictions.
exampleSentence: Inference cost per request dropped sharply after we adopted a smaller, distilled model.
exampleTranslation: 在采用一个更小的蒸馏模型之后，每次请求的推理成本大幅下降。

englishDefinition: Directing requests to different models based on factors like cost, complexity, or capability.
exampleSentence: Model routing sent simple questions to a cheap model and complex ones to a stronger one.
exampleTranslation: 模型路由把简单问题发送给了便宜的模型，把复杂问题发送给了更强的模型。

englishDefinition: Distributing incoming inference requests evenly across multiple servers or instances.
exampleSentence: Load balancing kept any single server from becoming overwhelmed during peak traffic.
exampleTranslation: 负载均衡避免了任何一台服务器在流量高峰期被压垮。

englishDefinition: Automatically adjusting the number of running instances based on current demand.
exampleSentence: Autoscaling added extra inference servers automatically when traffic spiked.
exampleTranslation: 流量激增时，自动扩缩容会自动增加推理服务器的数量。

englishDefinition: The delay experienced when a model or service must be initialized before handling its first request.
exampleSentence: The cold start added almost ten seconds of delay to the first request after idle time.
exampleTranslation: 空闲一段时间后的第一次请求，冷启动会额外增加将近十秒的延迟。

englishDefinition: The percentage of a GPU's computational capacity actually being used.
exampleSentence: Low GPU utilization suggested the model wasn't taking full advantage of the hardware.
exampleTranslation: 较低的 GPU 利用率说明模型并没有充分利用硬件性能。

englishDefinition: Grouping multiple inference requests together to process them more efficiently.
exampleSentence: Inference batching combined requests from different users into a single GPU pass.
exampleTranslation: 推理批处理把来自不同用户的请求合并到了同一次 GPU 计算中。

englishDefinition: Storing previously computed model outputs to avoid redundant computation for repeated inputs.
exampleSentence: Output caching returned the same answer instantly the second time an identical question was asked.
exampleTranslation: 当同一个问题第二次被提出时，输出缓存能立即返回相同的答案。

englishDefinition: Running a few initial requests through a model after startup to reduce latency on real requests.
exampleSentence: Model warm-up before opening traffic avoided a slow first response for real users.
exampleTranslation: 在开放流量之前进行模型预热，避免了真实用户遇到较慢的首次响应。

englishDefinition: The sequence of preprocessing, model execution, and postprocessing steps used to serve predictions.
exampleSentence: The inference pipeline resized the image, ran the model, and formatted the result automatically.
exampleTranslation: 这套推理流水线自动完成了图像缩放、模型运行和结果格式化的全过程。

englishDefinition: Holding incoming requests in a queue until the system has capacity to process them.
exampleSentence: Request queuing prevented the server from crashing during the traffic surge.
exampleTranslation: 请求排队避免了服务器在流量激增期间崩溃。

englishDefinition: Multiple inference requests being processed by a system at the same time.
exampleSentence: The server handled two hundred concurrent inference requests without slowing down.
exampleTranslation: 这台服务器在处理两百个并发推理请求时依然没有出现延迟。

englishDefinition: Moving parts of a model's computation to different hardware, such as CPU or disk, to save GPU memory.
exampleSentence: Model offloading let the huge model run on a machine with limited GPU memory.
exampleTranslation: 模型卸载让这个庞大的模型能够在 GPU 显存有限的机器上运行。

englishDefinition: Splitting individual model layers across multiple devices to run very large models.
exampleSentence: Tensor parallelism split each large matrix multiplication across four GPUs.
exampleTranslation: 张量并行把每次大型矩阵乘法运算拆分到了四张 GPU 上。

englishDefinition: Specialized hardware designed to speed up model inference computations.
exampleSentence: The inference accelerator ran the model five times faster than a general-purpose CPU.
exampleTranslation: 这个推理加速器让模型的运行速度比通用 CPU 快了五倍。

englishDefinition: Using specialized hardware, such as GPUs or TPUs, to speed up computation.
exampleSentence: Hardware acceleration made training feasible in days instead of months.
exampleTranslation: 硬件加速让训练能够在几天内完成，而不是几个月。

englishDefinition: Running a model directly on a user's device rather than sending data to a server.
exampleSentence: On-device inference kept the keyboard's autocomplete working even without an internet connection.
exampleTranslation: 端侧推理让键盘的自动补全功能即使在没有网络连接的情况下也能正常工作。

englishDefinition: Tracking the performance, errors, and behavior of a model in production over time.
exampleSentence: Inference monitoring alerted the team the moment response times started climbing.
exampleTranslation: 推理监控在响应时间刚开始上升时就立即向团队发出了警报。

englishDefinition: The proportion of a model's predictions that are correct.
exampleSentence: The model reached ninety-two percent accuracy on the held-out test set.
exampleTranslation: 这个模型在留出的测试集上达到了 92% 的准确率。

englishDefinition: The proportion of a model's positive predictions that are actually correct.
exampleSentence: High precision meant very few of the flagged transactions turned out to be false alarms.
exampleTranslation: 较高的精确率意味着被标记的交易中很少是误报。

englishDefinition: The proportion of actual positive cases that a model correctly identifies.
exampleSentence: Improving recall meant the model caught more fraud cases, even with a few more false alarms.
exampleTranslation: 提升召回率意味着模型能捕捉到更多的欺诈案例，即使会多出几个误报。

englishDefinition: A metric that balances precision and recall into a single number.
exampleSentence: The F1 score was a better summary metric than accuracy for this imbalanced dataset.
exampleTranslation: 对于这个不平衡的数据集，F1 分数是比准确率更好的综合指标。

englishDefinition: A metric that measures a classifier's ability to distinguish between classes across all thresholds.
exampleSentence: An AUC-ROC close to 1.0 indicated the model separated the two classes very well.
exampleTranslation: AUC-ROC 接近 1.0，说明模型很好地区分开了这两个类别。

englishDefinition: A metric that measures how well a language model predicts a sample of text; lower is better.
exampleSentence: Perplexity dropped significantly after training on a larger, more diverse corpus.
exampleTranslation: 在更大、更多样化的语料库上训练后，困惑度显著下降了。

englishDefinition: A metric that measures how closely machine-generated text matches a set of reference translations.
exampleSentence: The BLEU score improved by five points after we fine-tuned the translation model.
exampleTranslation: 在对翻译模型进行微调之后，BLEU 分数提高了五分。

englishDefinition: A metric used to evaluate the quality of automatically generated summaries against reference summaries.
exampleSentence: The ROUGE score showed the generated summary captured most of the key points.
exampleTranslation: ROUGE 分数显示，生成的摘要涵盖了大部分关键要点。

englishDefinition: Assessing model outputs using judgments from human raters rather than automated metrics.
exampleSentence: Human evaluation confirmed the model's answers were not just accurate but also easy to read.
exampleTranslation: 人工评估证实了模型的回答不仅准确，而且易于阅读。

englishDefinition: Assessing model outputs using programmatic metrics without human review.
exampleSentence: Automated evaluation ran on every new model checkpoint without any manual effort.
exampleTranslation: 自动化评估在每个新的模型检查点上运行，完全不需要人工干预。

englishDefinition: A standardized dataset and set of tasks used to measure and compare model performance.
exampleSentence: The new model topped the evaluation benchmark that had been the industry standard for years.
exampleTranslation: 这个新模型在多年来一直是行业标准的评估基准上拿到了最高分。

englishDefinition: A portion of data set aside and never used during training, reserved for final evaluation.
exampleSentence: Performance on the held-out test set is the only number that really matters before launch.
exampleTranslation: 在上线之前，留出测试集上的表现才是唯一真正重要的数字。

englishDefinition: A public ranking of models based on their performance on a shared benchmark.
exampleSentence: The model climbed to third place on the public leaderboard within a week of release.
exampleTranslation: 发布仅一周，这个模型就在公开排行榜上升到了第三名。

englishDefinition: The process of examining a model's mistakes to understand patterns and guide improvements.
exampleSentence: Error analysis revealed the model consistently struggled with sarcasm.
exampleTranslation: 错误分析发现模型在处理讽刺语气时始终表现不佳。

englishDefinition: An experiment that removes or changes one component of a model to measure its individual contribution.
exampleSentence: The ablation study showed that removing the attention layer hurt performance the most.
exampleTranslation: 消融实验显示，移除注意力层对性能的损害最大。

englishDefinition: A simple reference model used as a point of comparison for more advanced approaches.
exampleSentence: The fancy new architecture barely beat the simple baseline model.
exampleTranslation: 这个花哨的新架构相较于简单的基线模型，优势并不明显。

englishDefinition: A measure of whether an observed result is unlikely to have occurred by chance.
exampleSentence: The improvement wasn't large enough to reach statistical significance.
exampleTranslation: 这次提升的幅度还不足以达到统计显著性。

englishDefinition: A measure of how much different human annotators agree when labeling the same data.
exampleSentence: Low inter-annotator agreement suggested the labeling instructions were too ambiguous.
exampleTranslation: 较低的标注者间一致性说明标注说明写得太模糊了。

englishDefinition: Deliberately probing a model with adversarial inputs to uncover weaknesses or unsafe behavior.
exampleSentence: Red teaming uncovered several prompts that bypassed the model's safety guidelines.
exampleTranslation: 红队测试发现了几个能够绕过模型安全规则的提示词。

englishDefinition: Testing a model with intentionally crafted inputs designed to cause it to fail.
exampleSentence: Adversarial testing revealed the classifier could be fooled by a single altered pixel.
exampleTranslation: 对抗性测试发现，仅改变一个像素就能骗过这个分类器。

englishDefinition: Evaluating how well a model maintains performance under noisy or unexpected conditions.
exampleSentence: Robustness testing checked how the model handled typos and unusual phrasing.
exampleTranslation: 鲁棒性测试检验了模型对拼写错误和非常规表达的处理能力。

englishDefinition: Assessing whether a model produces systematically unfair outcomes across different groups.
exampleSentence: Bias evaluation found the model performed worse on names from certain regions.
exampleTranslation: 偏见评估发现模型对某些地区的姓名处理效果较差。

englishDefinition: A quantitative measure used to assess whether a model treats different groups equitably.
exampleSentence: The fairness metric flagged a gap in approval rates between two demographic groups.
exampleTranslation: 这项公平性指标标出了两个人口群体在通过率上的差距。

englishDefinition: How well a model's predicted confidence scores match its actual accuracy.
exampleSentence: Poor calibration meant the model was often just as confident when wrong as when right.
exampleTranslation: 校准不佳意味着模型在犯错时的置信度往往和答对时一样高。

englishDefinition: Identifying inputs that differ significantly from the data a model was trained on.
exampleSentence: Out-of-distribution detection flagged an unusual input the model had never seen anything like.
exampleTranslation: 分布外检测标记出了一个模型此前从未见过的异常输入。

englishDefinition: Systematically evaluating multiple models against each other on the same tasks.
exampleSentence: Model comparison across five candidates narrowed the choice down to two finalists.
exampleTranslation: 对五个候选模型进行的模型对比，最终把选择范围缩小到了两个。

englishDefinition: The percentage of comparisons in which a model's output is preferred over an alternative.
exampleSentence: The new model had a seventy percent win rate against the previous version.
exampleTranslation: 这个新模型相对于上一版本的胜率达到了 70%。

englishDefinition: Evaluating two model outputs side by side to determine which one is better.
exampleSentence: Pairwise comparison made it easier for raters to judge quality than scoring each answer alone.
exampleTranslation: 成对比较让评分者判断质量时比单独给每个答案打分更容易。

englishDefinition: Using a language model itself to evaluate and score the outputs of other models.
exampleSentence: LLM-as-a-judge scaled up our evaluation without needing hundreds of human raters.
exampleTranslation: 大模型评判员让我们能够扩大评估规模，而不需要数百名人工评分员。

englishDefinition: An evaluation benchmark designed to test performance on one particular type of task.
exampleSentence: The task-specific benchmark for code generation revealed gaps a general benchmark had missed.
exampleTranslation: 这个针对代码生成的任务专项基准，揭示出了通用基准未能发现的差距。

englishDefinition: The software infrastructure used to run a model through a suite of evaluation tasks.
exampleSentence: The evaluation harness ran the model against forty different benchmarks overnight.
exampleTranslation: 这套评估框架在一夜之间让模型跑完了四十个不同的基准测试。

englishDefinition: Re-evaluating a model after changes to confirm previously working behavior hasn't broken.
exampleSentence: Regression testing caught a case where the new model performed worse on a previously easy question type.
exampleTranslation: 回归测试发现新模型在某类此前很容易处理的问题上，表现反而变差了。

englishDefinition: Assessing model outputs through descriptive review rather than numeric scores alone.
exampleSentence: Qualitative evaluation of the transcripts revealed tone issues that metrics alone missed.
exampleTranslation: 对对话记录进行的定性评估，发现了单纯依靠指标无法察觉的语气问题。

englishDefinition: Assessing model outputs using numeric metrics that can be measured and compared.
exampleSentence: Quantitative evaluation gave leadership a clear number to track release over release.
exampleTranslation: 定量评估为管理层提供了一个可以在每次发布中持续追踪的清晰数字。

englishDefinition: A curated set of examples used specifically to measure model performance.
exampleSentence: The evaluation dataset was carefully balanced across every category the model needed to handle.
exampleTranslation: 这个评估数据集在模型需要处理的每个类别之间都做了精心的平衡。

englishDefinition: The portion of data used to teach a model during the training process.
exampleSentence: The training dataset contained two million labeled examples.
exampleTranslation: 这个训练数据集包含两百万个已标注的样本。

englishDefinition: A separate portion of data used to evaluate a model's final performance.
exampleSentence: The model was never exposed to the test dataset during training.
exampleTranslation: 这个模型在训练过程中从未接触过测试数据集。

englishDefinition: The process of assigning correct labels or categories to raw data for training purposes.
exampleSentence: Data labeling for the image dataset took a team of ten annotators three weeks.
exampleTranslation: 这份图像数据集的数据标注工作，由十人组成的标注团队花了三周才完成。

englishDefinition: The process of adding informative tags or notes to raw data to prepare it for training.
exampleSentence: Data annotation guidelines were updated after annotators disagreed on edge cases.
exampleTranslation: 在标注人员对边界情况出现分歧后，数据标注指南进行了更新。

englishDefinition: A document that provides rules and examples for how to label data consistently.
exampleSentence: A clear annotation guideline reduced disagreements between different labelers.
exampleTranslation: 清晰的标注指南减少了不同标注人员之间的分歧。

englishDefinition: The automated sequence of steps that moves and transforms data from source to model.
exampleSentence: The data pipeline pulled fresh data every night and prepared it for the next training run.
exampleTranslation: 这条数据流水线每晚都会拉取最新数据，并为下一次训练做好准备。

englishDefinition: The process of detecting and correcting errors or inconsistencies in a dataset.
exampleSentence: Data cleaning removed thousands of duplicate and corrupted entries before training began.
exampleTranslation: 数据清洗在训练开始之前去除了成千上万条重复和损坏的记录。

englishDefinition: The steps taken to transform raw data into a format suitable for model training.
exampleSentence: Data preprocessing normalized every numeric column to the same scale.
exampleTranslation: 数据预处理把每个数值型字段都归一化到了相同的尺度。

englishDefinition: Techniques that artificially expand a training dataset by creating modified versions of existing data.
exampleSentence: Data augmentation tripled the effective size of our small training set.
exampleTranslation: 数据增强让我们这个小规模训练集的有效数据量增加到了三倍。

englishDefinition: A situation where some classes in a dataset are much more common than others.
exampleSentence: Data imbalance meant the model saw a hundred times more normal transactions than fraudulent ones.
exampleTranslation: 数据不平衡意味着模型接触到的正常交易数量是欺诈交易的一百倍。

englishDefinition: Selecting a representative subset of data from a larger dataset for training or analysis.
exampleSentence: Data sampling kept the dataset manageable while preserving its overall distribution.
exampleTranslation: 数据采样在保留整体分布特征的同时，让数据集的规模变得可控。

englishDefinition: Tracking and managing different versions of a dataset over time.
exampleSentence: Data versioning let us trace exactly which dataset version had trained each model.
exampleTranslation: 数据版本管理让我们能够精确追溯每个模型是用哪个版本的数据集训练出来的。

englishDefinition: A record of where data originated and how it has been transformed over time.
exampleSentence: Data lineage traced the feature all the way back to its original raw source.
exampleTranslation: 数据血缘把这个特征一路追溯到了它最原始的数据来源。

englishDefinition: The overall accuracy, completeness, and reliability of a dataset.
exampleSentence: Poor data quality was the real reason the model kept underperforming, not the architecture.
exampleTranslation: 数据质量不佳才是模型持续表现不佳的真正原因，而不是架构问题。

englishDefinition: A change over time in the statistical properties of the data a model receives in production.
exampleSentence: Data drift meant the model trained last year no longer matched today's user behavior.
exampleTranslation: 数据漂移意味着去年训练的模型已经不再匹配今天的用户行为。

englishDefinition: A change over time in the underlying relationship between input data and the target outcome.
exampleSentence: Concept drift explained why fraud patterns the model learned last quarter no longer applied.
exampleTranslation: 概念漂移解释了为什么模型上个季度学到的欺诈模式已经不再适用。

englishDefinition: A dataset generated artificially rather than collected from real-world events.
exampleSentence: The synthetic dataset simulated rare failure scenarios that almost never appeared in real logs.
exampleTranslation: 这个合成数据集模拟出了几乎不会出现在真实日志中的罕见故障场景。

englishDefinition: Collecting data labels from a large, distributed group of people rather than a small internal team.
exampleSentence: Crowdsourced labeling let us annotate a hundred thousand images within a week.
exampleTranslation: 众包标注让我们能在一周之内为十万张图像完成标注。

englishDefinition: Generating approximate labels using rules or heuristics instead of careful manual annotation.
exampleSentence: Weak labeling from keyword rules gave us a rough starting point before manual review.
exampleTranslation: 基于关键词规则的弱标注，在人工审核之前为我们提供了一个粗略的起点。

englishDefinition: The process of identifying and removing duplicate records from a dataset.
exampleSentence: Data deduplication cut the training corpus size by fifteen percent.
exampleTranslation: 数据去重把训练语料的规模减少了 15%。

englishDefinition: Practices and protections that ensure personal or sensitive data is handled responsibly.
exampleSentence: Data privacy requirements meant we had to strip personal information before training.
exampleTranslation: 数据隐私要求我们在训练之前必须去除个人信息。

englishDefinition: The process of removing or obscuring identifying information from a dataset.
exampleSentence: Anonymization replaced every customer name with a random identifier before analysis.
exampleTranslation: 匿名化在分析之前把每个客户姓名都替换成了随机标识符。

englishDefinition: The policies and processes that ensure data is managed properly across an organization.
exampleSentence: Data governance defined who was allowed to access the raw customer dataset.
exampleTranslation: 数据治理规定了谁有权限访问原始客户数据集。

englishDefinition: Data organized in a clearly defined format, such as tables with rows and columns.
exampleSentence: Structured data from the database was much easier to work with than raw text logs.
exampleTranslation: 来自数据库的结构化数据，处理起来比原始文本日志容易得多。

englishDefinition: Data without a predefined format, such as free-form text, images, or audio.
exampleSentence: Unstructured data like support call recordings required extra preprocessing before use.
exampleTranslation: 像客服通话录音这样的非结构化数据，在使用之前需要额外的预处理。

englishDefinition: Descriptive information about a dataset, such as its source, format, or collection date.
exampleSentence: The metadata showed exactly when and from which source each record was collected.
exampleTranslation: 元数据清楚地显示出每条记录的采集时间和来源。
